nodes.label: DEV-9 Jira Token Vault Encryption Design
nodes.rationale: Approach 1 (security-definer SQL helpers + secret UUID in settings) chosen so the Jira API token is encrypted at rest in Supabase Vault and only decryptable via service_role RPCs; on save-failure surface the error and never fall back to a plaintext write, keeping BB-NFR-04/AC-9 guarantees intact.
nodes.norm_label: dev-9 jira token vault encryption design

nodes.label: Health Endpoints & Ops Runbook Design
nodes.rationale: Thin routes + shared helpers (Approach 1) with health endpoints kept public so uptime probes work signed-out; worker depth uses env-flag presence plus latest bug_budget_sync_runs summary to avoid coupling to Inngest's external API, and secrets are masked/absent in all responses.

nodes.label: BB-MIG-01/02 Bulk Copy + Reconciliation Design
nodes.rationale: Approach A byte-copies legacy QARATMS MySQL rows straight into Postgres via @momus/migration CLI rather than resyncing from Jira, preserving ids and reconciling by COUNT, per-year and SHA-256 checksum against the 4653-row baseline so history is provably intact.

nodes.label: BB-MIG-03/04 Settings Migration + Parallel-Run Diffs Design
nodes.rationale: Migrate only non-secret settings and never copy jira_api_token (re-entered via Vault/Settings UI); preserve legacy PHP last-wins duplicate/typo keys for fidelity; diff CLI reuses @momus/domain reconcile plus stable JSON fingerprints and buildBugBudgetCsv body hash, exiting 1 on hard mismatch.
nodes.norm_label: bb-mig-03/04 settings migration + parallel-run diffs design

nodes.label: BB-MIG-05/06 Cutover & Rollback Design
nodes.rationale: QARATMS app and DB will be deleted making Momus the sole source of truth with no MySQL compatibility layer; rollback is a 30-day read-only standby with route-flip, explicitly warned not to merge Momus-only writes.

nodes.label: Defect Analytics (Momus) Design
nodes.rationale: Extends the existing analytics MVP (packages/domain + /api/analytics + homepage dashboard) strictly M1->M5 TDD-first; uses issue_type (not Bug Budget final_issue_type) for grouping, Asia/Jakarta buckets, a 24-month default window, and cache invalidation on successful Bug Budget sync.

nodes.label: Open Bug Summary Key/Severity Design
nodes.rationale: UI-only change to the Open Bug/Defect Summary modal: hyperlink the issue Key to Jira browse, add a Severity column from existing SummaryIssue.severity, and order year filter newest->oldest, with no domain/API contract changes beyond passing jira_browse_base.
